links.outcome: Pathologist diagnostic accuracy and time with vs without AI assistance for lymph node metastasis detection
links.effect: PANseg augmented the diagnostic accuracy of 6 pathologists from 0.888 to 0.961, while reducing the average diagnostic time by 32.6% (72.0 vs 48.5 minutes).
links.quote: In lymph node metastasis detection, PANseg augmented the diagnostic accuracy of 6 pathologists from 0.888 to 0.961, while reducing the average diagnostic time by 32.6% (72.0 vs 48.5 minutes).

links.outcome: Performance on external test set and unseen sample types versus internal tests
links.effect: External AUROC 0.950 vs FSB 0.958; unseen fresh-frozen specimens AUROC 0.878 and biopsy sections 0.821, lower than internal (0.969-0.991).
links.quote: Moreover, the model demonstrated considerable generalizability with previously unseen sample types, attaining AUROCs of 0.878 on fresh-frozen specimens (20 patients/20 WSIs) and 0.821 on biopsy sections (20 patients/20 WSIs).

unlisted_practices: weakly supervised training with image-level labels to reduce annotation burden

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study with 6 pathologists comparing diagnostic accuracy and reading time with and without AI assistance (PANseg).
